reviews.text: This outdoor cooling/heating system is amazing, especially in Texas. Moat misters leave you wet, but these keep you totally dry while cooling or heating up to 15-20 degrees if I remember correctly. I first learned about them at a Christmas event that was chilly, but left us all comfortable outdoors without feeling like our hair was melting off (IYKYK) Forrest and Danielle are both so kind, informative, and truly care about their customers. This is a must for all commercial spaces, custom homes, and anyone that likes to entertain!
reviews.author: Stephanie Shepherd

reviews.text: Forrest was very responsive and helpful in working with us to plan heating and cooling for our outdoor living space.  He had great ideas and provided recommendations that fit our budget, and he worked closely with our general contractor to ensure everything was installed properly. He and his team went above and beyond to ensure we were happy with our purchase.  I highly recommend hiring Forrest for your outdoor cooling and heating needs!
reviews.author: Steve Richins

reviews.text: the JetStream system has extended the time we get to enjoy our outdoor living area.  The customer service is easy and hassle free.  I would (and have) highly recommend the system.
reviews.author: Mark Anderson

reviews.text: IF YOU HAVE A RESTAURANT, DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY!! They will take your machine and hold it hostage until you renew your contract. By the time I got my system last year, Summer was halfway over. Again this year, someone came out to winterize the system and disconnected it after I told them i didn't want them touching it. Now it is Summer again and when I called FORREST WOODS back to put it back together, he refused because i didn't pay for another year and hung up on me.  Steer clear of this company and their scam.
reviews.author: Michael Escobedo (Mike)

reviews.text: This company has always gone above and beyond with my cooling system.      Including when the builders sub contractor messed things up with the plumbing to the system....JestStream handled the repairs without question or charge to me.
reviews.author: TRM TRM

reviews.text: Forrest was a pleasure to work with and the system works great! Can't wait for the next system we install together.
reviews.author: Nick Zuckerbrow

reviews.text: Provided a more detailed review on Yelp.   I highly recommend JetStream.  Great service and awesome outdoor cooling!
reviews.author: Ron Pruitt

data.summary: The reviews appear largely authentic but the overall volume is very low, making patterns harder to discern. The single, detailed 1-star complaint raises a significant red flag about business practices regarding contracts and equipment. Positive reviews are generally plausible but not overwhelmingly detailed. The mix of dates and styles suggests organic, not fabricated, reviews.
fake_signals: Low total review volume across all platforms
Several 5-star reviews from 6+ years ago with minimal detail
One review (Lloyd LeBlanc) appears to be for a restaurant, not a contractor
authentic_signals: Specific negative complaint with detailed narrative (Michael Escobedo)
Positive reviews mention owner/employee names (Forrest, Danielle) and specific benefits (dry cooling)
Varied writing styles and timeframes (reviews span 9 years to 3 months)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are reasonably consistent. Google (4.6) and Houzz (5.0) are high, while Yelp (3.9) is slightly lower but not a major red flag. The low review volume makes minor differences less significant.
